A graph with two panels stacked vertically. The top panel shows the Total Product (TP) curve rising initially at an increasing rate, then at a decreasing rate, reaching a peak, and then falling. The bottom panel shows the Average Product (AP) and Marginal Product (MP) curves. MP rises rapidly, peaks before AP, then falls, intersecting AP exactly at AP's maximum point. MP continues to fall, crossing the horizontal axis (becoming zero) exactly at the vertical line where TP is at its maximum. Vertical dashed lines divide the graphs into three stages: Stage 1 ends at the intersection of AP and MP. Stage 2 ends where MP crosses the zero line. Stage 3 is where MP is negative. Axes are on the x-axis, and "Output" on the y-axes. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
